Source: One way to achieve this is the creation of groups, called multi-stakeholder platforms (MSPs), that include representatives from many different institutions, like the government, universities and non-profit organisations.

Yoruba: Ọ̀nà kan lahti gbà rí èyí ṣe ni ìdásílẹ̀ àwọn ọ̀wọ́, tí wọ́n ń pè ní ààyè-ìmúṣẹ́ṣe ọlọ́pọ̀-alẹ́nulọ́rọ̀ (MSPs), èyí tí ó ní àwọn aṣojú láti àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ bíi ti ìjọba, ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga àti àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n kò torí èrè jíjẹ dá sílẹ̀.
Zulu: Enye indlela yokufeza lokhu ukwakhiwa kwamaqembu, abizwa ngama-multi-takeholder platforms (MSPs), ahlanganisa abamele izikhungo eziningi ezahlukene, njengohulumeni, amanyuvesi kanye nezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo.
Hausa: Hanya ɗaya don cim ma wannan ita ce ƙirƙirar ƙungiyoyi, waɗanda ake kira dandalin masu ruwa da tsaki da yawa (MSPs), waɗanda suka haɗa da wakilai daga cibiyoyi daban-daban, kamar gwamnati da jami'o'i da ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu.
Northern Sotho: Tsela e tee ya go fihlelela se ke go hlama dihlophas, tše di bitšwago dibaka tša bakgathatema ka bontši (di-MSP), tšeo di akaretšago baemedi go tšwa go dihlongwa tše ntši tše di fapafapanego, tša go swana le mmušo, diyunibesithi le mekgatlo ya go se dire letseno.
Amharic: ይህንን ለማሳካት አንዱ መንገድ ከተለያዩ ተቋማት እንደ መንግሥት፣ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች እና ለትርፍ-ያልተቋቋሙ ድርጅቶች ካሉት የተውጣጡ ተወካዮችን የሚያካትቱ፣ የባለብዙ-ባለድርሻ አካላት መድረክ (MSPs)፣ የሚባሉ ቡድኖችን መፍጠር ነው።

Source: In this study, the researchers wanted to find out whether creating MSPs would lead to better climate change policies.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula oba ng’okutondawo MSPs kiyinza okuviirako okukola amateeka agakwata ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde amalungi.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà fẹ́ wádìí bóyá dída àwọn MSP sílẹ̀ yóò yọrí sí àwọn ìlànà-ìmúṣẹ́ṣe tí ó túnbọ̀ dára fún àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola ukuthi ukudala ama-MSP kuzoholela yini kuzinqubomgomo ezingcono zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su gano ko ƙirƙirar MSPs zai haifar da ingantattun manufofin sauyin yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge eba go hlama di-MSP go ka feletša ka melawana ye mekaone ya mabapi le phetogo ya tlelaemete.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ MSPs መፍጠር ወደተሻለ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ፖሊሲዎች ይመራ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

Source: Between 2014-2017, they monitored 8 MSPs that were created as part of a larger project about climate change and agriculture in Uganda and Tanzania.
Luganda: Wakati wa 2014-2017, baalondoola MSPs 8 ebyatondebwawo ng’ekitundu ku pulojekiti engazi ekwata ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde n’ebyobulimi mu Uganda ne Tanzania.
Yoruba: Láàrin 2014-2017, wọ́n tọpa àwọn MSP 8 tí wọ́n dá sílẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ara àpapọ̀ àkànṣe-iṣẹ́ ńlá fún àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ àti ètò ohun ọ̀gbìn ní Uganda àti Tanzania.
Zulu: Phakathi kuka-2014-2017, baqaphe ama-MSP ayi-8 adalwe njengengxenye yephrojekthi enkulu mayelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kanye nezolimo e-Uganda naseTanzania.
Hausa: A tsakanin shekarar 2014 zuwa 2017, sun sanya-ido a kan MSPs guda 8 waɗanda aka ƙirƙira a matsayin wani ɓangare na babban aiki game da sauyin yanayi da noma a Yuganda da kuma Tanzaniya.
Northern Sotho: Magareng ga 2014-2017, ba ile ba hlokomela di-MSP tše 8 tšeo di ile tša hlangwa bjalo ka karolo ya protšeke ye kgolo ka ga phetogo ya tlelaemete le bolemi ka Uganda le ka Tanzania.
Amharic: በ2014-2017 መካከል፣ በኡጋንዳ እና ታንዛኒያ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና ግብርና ላይ እንደ የትልቅ ፕሮጀክት አካል ሆነው የተፈጠሩ 8 MSPsን ተቆጣጠሩ።

Source: The researchers attended the same meetings as the members of the MSP groups and used questionnaires to find out how much the members knew about climate change and policy-making processes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagenda mu nkiiko ezaalimu bammemba b’ebibiina bya MSPs era ne bakozesa questionnaires okusobola okuzuula bammemba kye baali bamanyi ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde n’emitendera egiyitibwamu mu kukola amateeka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà lọ ìpàdé kan-náà pẹ̀lú àwọn tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àwọn MSP wọ́n sì lo àtòjọ-ìbéèrè láti wádìí bí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ náà ṣe nímọ̀ nípa àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ àti àwọn ìṣàgbékalẹ̀ ìlànà ìmúṣẹ́ṣe tó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bahambele imihlangano efanayo namalungu amaqembu e-MSP futhi basebenzisa uhlu lwemibuzo ukuze bathole ukuthi amalungu ayazi kangakanani ngokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nezinqubo zokwenza inqubomgomo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun halarci tarurruka iri ɗaya da membobin ƙungiyoyin MSP kuma sun yi amfani da jerin tambayoyi domin gano zurfin saninsu game da sauyin yanayi da hanyoyin aiwatar da manufofin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba tsenela dikopano tša go swana le tše bjalo ka maloko a dihlopha tša MSP gomme ba šomiša dipotšišo tša dinyakišišo go tseba gore ke maloko a makae ao a bego a tseba ka ga phetogo ya tlelaemete le ditshepedišo tša go hlama melawana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከMSP ቡድኖች አባላት ጋር በተመሳሳይ ስብሰባዎች ላይ ተገኝተዋል እና አባላት ስለ አየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና ስለ ፖሊሲ-አወጣጥ ሂደቶች ምን ያህል እንደሚያውቁ ለማወቅ መጠይቆችን ተጠቅመዋል።

Source: They also asked whether MSP members knew about climate adaptation strategies that could be used in specific areas.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baabuuza oba nga bammemba ba MSPs baali bamanyi ebikwata ku nkola z’okutambula n’embeera y’obudde ezisobola okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún bèèrè bóyá àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé àwọn MSP mọ̀ nípa àwọn ète ìfaramọ́lé ojú-ọjọ́ tí wọ́n lè lò ní àwọn agbègbè kan ní pàtó.
Zulu: Baphinde babuza ukuthi ngabe amalungu e-MSP ayazi yini ngamasu okushintsha isimo sezulu angasetshenziswa ezindaweni ezithile.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sun yi tambaya ko membobin MSP sun san dabarun daidaita yanayin da za a iya amfani da su a takamaiman wurare.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba botšiša gape ge eba maloko a MSP a be a tseba ka ga maano a tlwaelo ya tlelaemete ao a ka šomišwago mafelong a itšego.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የMSP አባላት በተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ ስለሚችሉ የአየር ንብረት ማላመድ ስልቶችን ያውቁ እንደሆነ ጠይቀዋል።

Source: These strategies allow people in rural areas to adapt to climate change by using “climate-smart” approaches, like growing different crops or managing their water supply more efficiently.
Luganda: Enkola zino zisobozesa abantu mu byalo okutambula n’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde nga bakozesa enkola ezirimu okubala embeera y’obudde, gamba ng’okulima ebirime eby’enjawulo oba okufuga obulungi amazzi ge bafuna.
Yoruba: Àwọn ète wọ̀nyí ni yóò fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n wà ní ìgbèríko láàyè láti fara mọ́ àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ nípa lílo ìlànà “àyíniké ojú-ọjọ́” bí gbígbin oríṣìíríṣìí irúgbìn tàbí ṣíṣàkóso fífún wọn lómi dáadáa.
Zulu: Lawa masu avumela abantu basezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuthi bavumelane nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ngokusebenzisa izindlela “ezihlakaniphile zesimo sezulu,” njengokutshala izitshalo ezahlukene noma ukuphatha amanzi ngendlela ephumelelayo.
Hausa: Waɗannan dabarun suna ba wa mutane a yankunan karkara damar daidaitawa da sauyin yanayi ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin "noman zamani", kamar noman amfanin gona daban-daban ko sarrafa ruwansu yadda ya kamata.
Northern Sotho: Maano a a dumelela batho ba ka dinagamagaeng go tlwaela phetogo ya tlelaemete ka go šomiša mekgwa ye “bohlale go tlelaemete”, ya go swana le go bjala dibjalo tše di fapanego goba go laola kabo ya bona ya meetse gabotse kudu.
Amharic: እነዚህ ስልቶች በገጠር ያሉ ሰዎች እንደ የተለያዩ ሰብሎችን ማምረት ወይም የውሃ አቅርቦታቸውን በብቃት ማስተዳደር ያሉ፣ “ከየአየር ንብረት ጋር ተስማሚ” አቀራረቦችን በመጠቀም ከአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ጋር እንዲላመዱ ያስችላቸዋል።

Source: Finally, the researchers asked members of two of the MSPs about the organisations they worked with.
Luganda: N’ekisembayo, abanoonyereza baabuuza bammemba b’ebitongole bya MSPs bibiri ebikwata ku bitongole bye bakoleramu.
Yoruba: Lákòótán, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà bi àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé MSP méjì nípa àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n ń bá ṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Ekugcineni, abacwaningi babuza amalungu amabili e-MSP mayelana nezinhlangano abasebenza nazo.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, masu binciken sun tambayi membobin biyu daga cikin MSPs game da ƙungiyoyin da suke aiki da su.
Northern Sotho: Sa mafelelo, banyakišiši ba ile ba botšiša maloko a di-MSP tše pedi ka ga mekgatlo yeo ba šomilego le yona.
Amharic: በመጨረሻም፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ አብረው ስለሚሰሩባቸው ድርጅቶች ሁለቱ የMSPs አባላትን ጠየቁ።

Source: They were interested in finding out how different organisations shared knowledge about climate change projects and guidelines.
Luganda: Baali baagala okumanya engeri ebitongole eby’enjawulo gye bigabanamu amagezi agakwata ku pulojekiti n’ebigobererwa ebyekuusa ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Ohun tí ó jẹ wọ́n lógún ni wíwá iye ilé-iṣẹ́ tí wọ́n nímọ̀ nípa àwọn àkànse-iṣẹ́ lórí àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ àti àwọn ìlànà wọn.
Zulu: Babenentshisekelo yokuthola ukuthi izinhlangano ezahlukene zabelana kanjani ngolwazi mayelana namaphrojekthi neziqondiso zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Hausa: Sun yi sha'awar gano yadda ƙungiyoyi daban-daban suke musayar ilimi game da ayyukan sauyin yanayi da kuma jagororin.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba na le kgahlego ya go tseba gore mekgatlo ye e fapanego e fan aka tsebo bjang ya mabapi le diprotšeke tša phetogo ya tlelaemete le ditlhahli.
Amharic: የተለያዩ ድርጅቶች የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ፕሮጀክቶችን እና መመሪያዎች እውቀትን እንዴት እንደሚጋሩ ለማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

Source: The researchers found that at the start of the MSP meetings, most of the members knew about the impacts of climate change, but very few knew about adaptation strategies that could be used in specific areas, and only some knew about policy-making processes.
Luganda: Abanonyereza baazuula nti ku ntandikwa y’enkiiko za MSPs, bammemba abasinga obungi baali balina kye bamanyi ku biva mu nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde, naye batono nnyo abaalina kye bamanyi ku nkola ez’okutambula nayo eziyinza okukozesebwa mu bitundu ebimu, era ng’abamu ku bo abatonotono baalina kye bamanyi ku mitendera egiyitibwamu okukola amateeka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà rí i pé ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ MSP náà, ọpọ̀ nínú àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé ni wọ́n mọ̀ nípa ipa àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́, àmọ́ díẹ̀ nínú wọn ló mọ̀ nípa àwọn ète ìfamọ́lé tí ó lè jẹ́ lílò ní àwọn agbègbè kọ̀ọ̀kan, díẹ̀ ló sì mọ̀ nípa ìṣàgbékalẹ̀ àwọn ìlànà ìmúṣẹ́ṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi ekuqaleni kwemihlangano ye-MSP, amalungu amaningi ayazi ngemithelela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, kodwa ambalwa kakhulu ayazi ngamasu okuzivumelanisa nezimo angasetshenziswa ezindaweni ezithile, futhi abanye kuphela ababebazi ngezinqubo zokwenza inqubomgomo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa a farkon tarurrukan MSP, yawancin membobin sun san tasirin sauyin yanayi, amma kaɗan ne suka san dabarun daidaitawa waɗanda za a iya amfani da su a takamaiman wurare, kuma wasu ne kawai suka san wani abu game da hanyoyin aiwatar da manufofin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba utolla gore mathomong a dikopano tša MSP, bontši bja maloko ba be ba tseba ka ga diabe tša phetogo ya tlelaemete, eupša ke ba mmalwa kudu bao ba bego ba tseba ka ga maano a tlwaelo ao a ka šomišwago ka makaleng a itšego, gome ke fela ba bangwe bao ba bego ba tseba ka ga ditshepedišop tša go hlama melawana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በMSPs ስብሰባዎች መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አባላት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተፅእኖን እንደሚያውቁ ደርሰውበታል፣ ነገር ግን በተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ጥቅም ላይ ሊውሉ ስለሚችሉ የማስተካከያ ስልቶች የሚያውቁት ጥቂቶች ብቻ ናቸው፣ እና የተወሰኑት ብቻ ስለ ፖሊሲ-አወጣጥ ሂደቶች ያውቃሉ።

Source: Over time, however, the MSP members learned a lot more about climate change adaptation from experts who gave talks during their meetings.
Luganda: Okumala ebbanga eriwera, bammemba ba MSPs baayiga ebintu ebirala bingi ebikwata ku nkola z’okutambula n’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde okuva mu bakugu abaayogerako gye bali ng’enkiiko zigenda mu maaso.
Yoruba: Bọhjọ́ ṣe ń gorí ọjọ́, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé MSP kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ púpọ̀ nípa ìfaramọ́lé àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ sí i lọ́dọ̀ àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ tí wọ́n sọ̀rọ̀ lásìkò àwọn ìpàdé wọn.
Zulu: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, amalungu e-MSP afunde okuningi mayelana nokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu kochwepheshe abethula izinkulumo phakathi nemihlangano yabo.
Hausa: Bayan lokaci, duk da haka, membobin MSP sun koyi abubuwa da yawa game da sauyin yanayi daga masana waɗanda suka bayar da jawabai a yayin tarurrukansu.
Northern Sotho: Ge nako e dutše e sepela, le ge go le bjale, maloko a MSP a ile a ithuta tše ntši kudu ka ga go tlwaela phetogo ya tlelaemete go tšwa go ditsebi tšeo di filego polelo ka dikopanong tša bona.
Amharic: ከጊዜ በኋላ፣ ግን፣ የMSP አባላት በስብሰባዎቻቸው ወቅት ንግግር ካደረጉ ባለሙያዎች ስለ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ማላመድ ብዙ ተምረዋል።

Source: The members said that they shared the knowledge they gained with other people in their communities, as well as politicians and colleagues.
Luganda: Bammemba baagamba nti amagezi ge baafuna baagagabana n’abantu abalala mu bitundu byabwe, awamu ne bannabyabufuzi ne banywanyi baabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé náà sọ pé àwọn fi ìmọ̀ tí àwọn kọ́ mọ àwọn ènìyàn mìíràn ní agbègbè wọn, àti àwọn olóṣèlú àti akẹgbẹ́.
Zulu: La malunga athe ulwazi aluzuzile alucobelela nabanye abantu emiphakathini yawo, nosopolitiki nozakwabo.
Hausa: Mambobin sun bayyana cewa, sun bayar da ilimin da suka samu ga sauran jama’ar yankinsu, da kuma ‘yan siyasa da abokan aikinsu.
Northern Sotho: Maloko a boletše gore ba fane ka tsebo ye ba e hweditšego go batho ba bangwe ka ditšhabeng tša bona, gammogo le boradipolotiki le bašomimmogo.
Amharic: አባላቱ ያገኙትን እውቀት ለሌሎች ማህበረሰቦች፣ ፖለቲከኞች እና የስራ ባልደረቦች ማካፈላቸውን ተናግረዋል።

Source: The researchers also found out that most organisations learned about climate change projects and guidelines from government departments, like the Forestry or Wildlife Department.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baazuula nti ebitongole ebisinga byamanya ku pulojekiti n’ebigobererwa ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde okuva mu bitongole bya gavumenti, gamba ng’ekitongole ekivunaanyizibwa ku bibira oba Ekitongole ekivunaanyizibwa ku butonde obw’omu nsiko.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún rí i pé ọ̀pọ̀ ilé-iṣẹ́ ni wọ́n ti kọ́ nípa àwọn àkànṣe-iṣẹ́ fún àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ àti àwọn ìlànà láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀ka ilé-ṣẹ́ ìjọba, bí ẹ̀ka ilé-iṣẹ́ nipá Igbó Kìjikìji àti àwọn ẹranko inú igbó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlangano eziningi zafunda ngamaphrojekthi neziqondiso zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu eminyangweni kahulumeni, njengoMnyango Wezamahlathi noma Wezilwane.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa yawancin ƙungiyoyi sun sami ilimi game da ayyukan sauyin yanayi da ƙa'idoji daga sassan gwamnati, kamar Sashen Gandun Daji ko na Namun Daji.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gape gore mekgatlo ye mentši e ithutile ka ga diprotšeke le ditlhahli ka ga phetogo ya tlelaemete go tšwa go dikgoro tša mmušo, tša go swana le Kgoro ya Kagodithokgwa goba ya Diphoofolo tša Nageng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪም አብዛኞቹ ድርጅቶች የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ፕሮጀክቶችን እና መመሪያዎችን እንደ ደን ወይም የዱር አራዊት ትምህርት ክፍሎች ካሉ፣ የመንግስት አካላት የተማሩ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።

Source: Through the MSPs, however, members had a chance to build new connections and found new ways to share information.
Luganda: Wabula okuyita mu MSPs, bammemba baafuna omukisa oguzimba enkolagana empya era ne bafuna engeri empya ez’okugabana obubaka.
Yoruba: Nípasẹ̀ àwọn MSP, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé ní àǹfààní láti túnbọ̀ mọra wọ́n sì àwọn ọ̀nà tuntun láti pín ìròyìn.
Zulu: Ngama-MSP, nokho, amalungu abe nethuba lokwakha ukuxhumana okusha futhi athola izindlela ezintsha zokwabelana ngolwazi.
Hausa: Ta hanyar MSPs, duk da haka, membobin sun sami damar gina sababbin alaƙoƙi kuma sun sami sababbin hanyoyin raba bayanai.
Northern Sotho: Ka di-MSP, le ge go le bjale, maloko a bile le sebaka sa go bopa dikgokagano tše diswa le go hwetša ditsela tše diswa tša go fana ka tshedimošo.
Amharic: በMSPs በኩል፣ ግን፣ አባላት አዳዲስ ግንኙነቶችን የመገንባት እድል ነበራቸው እና መረጃ የሚለዋወጡበት አዳዲስ መንገዶችን አግኝተዋል።

Source: Importantly, the researchers said that the MSPs had an influence on policies that were created at national or regional levels.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala, abanoonyereza baagamba nti MSPs byalina kye bikoze ku mateeka agaateekebwawo ku ddaala ly’eggwanga lyonna oba ku ddaala ly’ekitundu.
Yoruba: Ní pàtàkì, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ni àwọn MSP ní ipa lórí àwọn ìlànà-ìmúṣẹ́ṣe tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀dá ní ìpele orílẹ̀-èdè tàbi agbègbè.
Zulu: Okubalulekile, abacwaningi bathi ama-MSP abe nomthelela kuzinqubomgomo ezakhiwe ezingeni likazwelonke noma lesifunda.
Hausa: Abu mai muhimmanci shi ne, masu binciken sun ce MSPs suna da tasiri a kan manufofin da aka ƙirƙira a matakan ƙasa ko yanki.
Northern Sotho: Se bohlokwa ke gore, banyakišiši ba boletše gore di-MSP di bile le khuetšo go melawana ye e hlamilwego ka maemong a bosetšhaba le a dilete.
Amharic: በአስፈላጊ ሁኔታ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ MSPs በአገር አቀፍ ወይም በክልል ደረጃ በተፈጠሩ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ተፅእኖ ነበራቸው ብለዋል።

Source: In the smaller MSPs, for example, members discussed how specific areas could best adapt to climate change and made “climate-smart” recommendations that informed governmental development plans in those areas.
Luganda: Okugeza, mu MSPs ebitono, bammemba baakubaganya ebirowoozo ku ngeri ebitundu ebimu gye bisobola okutambula obulungi n’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde era ne bavaayo n’ebiteeso ebirimu okubala obulungi embeera y’obudde ebyeyambisibwa mu nteekateeka za gavumenti ez’enkulaakulana mu bitundu ebyo.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn MSP kékèèké, bí àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbé sọ̀rọ̀ nípa bí àwọn agbègbè kan ní pàtó ṣe lè faramọ́ àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ kí wọ́n sì dá àwọn àbá “àyínìke ojú-ọjọ” tí yóò gbe èrò ìdàgbàsókè ìjọba ní àwọn agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Kuma-MSP amancane, isibonelo, amalungu axoxisane ngokuthi izindawo ezithile zingavumelana kanjani kangcono nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu futhi enza izincomo “ezihlakaniphile zesimo sezulu” ezazisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kukahulumeni kulezo zindawo.
Hausa: A cikin ƙananan MSPs, alal misali, membobin sun tattauna yadda takamaiman wurare za su fi dacewa da sauyin yanayi kuma sun bayar da shawarwarin "noman zaman" waɗanda suke sanar da tsare-tsaren ci gaban gwamnati a waɗannan yankunan.
Northern Sotho: Ka go di-MSP tše nnyane, go fa mohlala, maloko a ile a ahlaahla ka fao Makala a itšego a ka feyogelago bokaone go cphetogo ya tlelaemete gomme ba dira ditšhišinyo tša mabapi le “bohlale go tlelaemete” tšeo hlahlilego maanotlhabollo a mmušo ka makaleng ao.
Amharic: በትንንሾቹ MSPs፣ ለምሳሌ፣ አባላት የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ከአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ጋር እንዴት በተሻለ ሁኔታ መላመድ እንደሚችሉ ተወያይተው በእነዚያ አካባቢዎች የመንግስት የልማት እቅዶችን የሚያሳውቁ “ከአየር ንብረት ጋር ተስማሚ” ምክሮችን ሰጥተዋል።

Source: The researchers say that these results show that creating MSPs can lead to better climate change policies, made with climate-smart science in mind.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti ebyazuulibwa bino biraga nti okutondawo MSPs kisobola okuviirako okukola amateeka ageekuusa ku nkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde agasingako, nga gakoleddwa okusinziira ku ssaayansi alimu okubala obulungi embeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn àbájáde wọ̀nyí fi hàn pé dídá àwọn MSP sílẹ̀ lè jásí àwọn ìlànà ìmúṣẹ́ṣe fún àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ tí ó dára, èyí tí wọ́n ní àyínike ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ojú-ọjọ́ lọ́kàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi le miphumela ibonisa ukuthi ukudala ama-MSP kungaholela emigomeni engcono yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, eyenziwe kucatshangelwa isayensi yesimo sezulu esihlakaniphile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce waɗannan sakamakon sun nuna cewa ƙirƙirar MSPs yana iya haifar da ingantattun manufofin sauyin yanayi, waɗanda aka yi da kimiyyar yanayi a zuciya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dipoelo tše di aletša gore go hlama di-MSP go ka feletša ka melawana ye mekaone ya phetogo ya tlelaemete, yeo e dirwago go naganwa ka ga mahlale a bohlale go tlelaemete.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ውጤቶች MSPsን መፍጠር ከአየር ንብረት ጋር ተስማሚ ሳይንስን ግምት ውስጥ በማስገባት ወደተሻለ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ፖሊሲ እንደሚያመራ ያሳያሉ ብለዋል።

Source: They add that future studies should look at whether MSPs continue to operate successfully in the long-term.
Luganda: Bongerako ne bagamba nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kufeeyo ku kulaba oba nga MSPs bisigala bikola bulungi mu bbanga eggwanvu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàfikún pé kí àwọn ìwádìí ọjọ́-iwájú wo bóyá àwọn MSP yóò ṣì máa ṣe àṣeyọrí lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ wọn bí wọ́n ṣe ń tẹ̀ síwájú.

Northern Sotho: Ba tlaleledditše ka gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di swanetše go lebelela ge eba di-MSP di tšwela pele go šoma ka katlego mo lebakeng la nako ye telele.
Amharic: ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች MSPs ለረጅም-ጊዜ በተሳካ ሁኔታ መስራታቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ መመልከት አለባቸው ሲሉ አክለዋል።

Source: They also say it’s important to investigate how many members of MSPs should be from the government versus other organisations to ensure their continued success.
Luganda: Bagamba era nti kya mugaso okunoonyereza ku muwendo gwa bammemba abasaanye okuva mu gavumenti bw’ogeraageranya ebitongole ebirala okukakasa nti bisigala bikola bulungi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé ó ṣe pàtàkì láti tọpinpin iye tí ó yẹ kí àwọn ti wọ́n darapọ̀ mọ́ àwọn MSP jẹ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba ní ìfojúrinjú pẹ̀lú àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ mìíràn láti rí pé àseyọrí wọn ń tẹ̀ síwájú.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi kubalulekile ukuphenya ukuthi mangaki amalungu e-MSP okufanele abe kuhulumeni uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yabo eqhubekayo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce yana da mahimmanci a binciki yawan membobin MSPs ya kamata su kasance daga gwamnati da sauran ƙungiyoyi don tabbatar da ci gaba da samun nasarar su.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gape gore go bohlokwa go nyakišiša gore ke maloko a makae a di-MSP ao a swanetšego go tšwa go mmušo ge go bapetšwa le ao a tšwago go mekgatlo ye mengwe go netefatša katlego ya bona ye e tšwelago pele.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ቀጣይ ስኬታቸውን ለማረጋገጥ የMSPs አባላት ምን ያህል ከመንግስት እና ከሌሎች ድርጅቶች መሆን እንዳለባቸው መመርመር አስፈላጊ ነው ይላሉ።

Source: The study was a collaboration between scientists from Uganda, Kenya, Colombia, the Netherlands and Vietnam.

Zulu: Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi base-Uganda, Kenya, Colombia, Netherlands kanye neVietnam.
